name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in smoky, harissa-spiked tomato sauce with plenty of feta.
recipeIngredient: 1 can fire-roasted tomatoes (28 oz, or crushed tomatoes)

recipeInstructions.text: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Sauté onion and red bell pepper until softened, 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute.
Stir in cumin, smoked paprika, harissa, and red pepper flakes. Let the spices bloom, 30 seconds.
Pour in fire-roasted tomatoes, season with salt and black pepper, and simmer until the sauce thickens slightly, 12 minutes.
Scatter half of the feta over the sauce. Make small wells and crack eggs into them. Cover, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook until the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 6-8 minutes.
Top with the rest of the feta, parsley, and a drizzle of olive oil. Serve straight from the skillet with crusty bread for dipping.
A pinch of sugar balances acidic tomatoes. Two 14.5 oz cans work if that's what you have; halve everything for two people. A dollop of Greek yogurt on top is good too.
